verdict.rationale: The product's own site labels the skill set MIT-licensed. The source is a public GitHub repo whose SKILL.md files are readable directly, which the runtime probe confirmed by fetching the repo. A community member also reports learning by reading the skills, so the source is independently shown to be readable. missing for 10: direct evidence of the LICENSE file in the repository itself; the MIT claim comes only from the marketing site.
